name: agent-run
title: Agent run
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Plan steps with tool chips, a tool-call activity log, a needs-input question, a draft diff with accept and reject, and run cost details.

meta.descriptionEs: Pasos del plan con herramientas, actividad de llamadas, una pregunta pendiente, un diff de borrador con aceptar o rechazar, y el costo de la corrida.

examples.title: Corrida del encargo
examples.description: Plan, JSON de actividad, tono pendiente y diff.

api.name: steps
api.description: Ordered plan. Each step can list tool chips.

api.name: activity
api.description: Tool calls. Expanding a row shows the JSON payload.

api.name: needsInput
api.description: A question with radio options. Null hides the block.

api.name: draft / onDecision
api.description: Line diff with Accept and Reject.

api.name: details
api.description: Model, tokens, cost, and duration. Display only.

docs: Inspirado en patrones de Affect UI (preview público); reimplementación clean-room; no código ni assets de Affect. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene, responde no. La pieza no trae tema, cssVars ni colores fijos. Instalar también trae @retana/app-shell.
